From one glass factory to the global partner

What began in 1864 as a small glass factory in Gerresheim near Düsseldorf has developed into a leading global partner to the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry.  This path has been characterized by innovation, change and the ability to constantly face new challenges. Join us on a journey through the milestones of our history - from the beginnings of glass production to today's specialization in innovative solutions for drug packaging and drug delivery devices.

  • From founding to shareholding company

    1864 The company was founded by Ferdinand Heye

    1864 - 1888

  • 1886 The biggest bottle maker in the world
  • 1888 Transformation into a joint stock company

  • Change

    1972 Renaming of the company. From this year onwards the company is called Gerresheimer Glas AG

    1972 - 1987

  • 1985 Relocation of headquarters
  • 1987 Development of tubing-based pharmaceutical glass product business

  • A historical turning point

    1999 Sale of the glassworks in Gerresheim

    1999

  • 1999 New global organization structure: strategic reorientation to focus on pharmaceutical, laboratory, cosmetic and small glass products

  • New global organizational structure & IPO

    2007 New global organization structure

    2007

  • 2007 Gerresheimer AG is stock exchange listed

  • New strategic positioning of the divisions

    2013 Divisional reorganization: Plastics & Devices, Primary Packaging Glass and Life Science Research

    2013 - 2016

  • 2015 Acquisition of Centor
  • 2015 Sale of tubing operations to Corning
  • 2016 Sale of Life Science Research operations

  • Current events

    2018 Gerresheimer acquires Swiss technology company Sensile Medical

    2018 - 2026

  • 2018 New CEO and Management Board of Gerresheimer AG: Dietmar Siemssen CEO, Dr. Bernd Metzner CFO, Dr. Lukas Burkhardt
  • 2019 Opening Plastic Packaging Plant in Changzhou, China
  • 2019 Focus on Innovation: new setup with new division Advanced Technology in addition to Primary Packaging Glass and Plastics & Devices
  • 2019 Opening Glass Innovation and Technology Center Vineland/NJ, USA
  • 2020 Opening Medical Device Plant Skopje, North Macedonia
  • 2021 New Corporate design
  • 2024 Acquisition of Bormioli Pharma Group
  • 2025 New CEO and Management Board of Gerresheimer AG: Uwe Röhrhoff CEO, Wolf Lehmann CFO, Achim Schalk
